en.joke: Just posted a 10-minute video explaining why I'm taking a break from social media, only to realize it's my most viral content yet.
en.explanation: It's post-ironic because it highlights the self-defeating absurdity of trying to escape social media while being rewarded by its very mechanics.

zh.joke: 我的健身卡已经躺在钱包里一年了，每次看到它，我都会感到一种平静。那是一种与世无争的佛系，象征着我与世俗欲望彻底和解，比如……八块腹肌。

people.name: Devan Nair
people.extract: Chengara Veetil Devan Nair was a Singaporean union leader and politician who served as the third president of Singapore from 1981 until his resignation in 1985.
highlights: Served as third president of Singapore (1981-1985).

people.name: Jesse Williams (actor)
people.extract: Jesse Wesley Williams is an American actor, director, producer, and activist best known as Dr. Jackson Avery on Grey's Anatomy. He has also appeared in films such as The Cabin in the Woods (2012) and The Butler (2013). He provided voice acting and motion capture for Markus in the video game Detroit: Become Human (2018).
highlights: Best known as Dr. Jackson Avery on Grey's Anatomy.
Appeared in films like The Cabin in the Woods.
Voice acted as Markus in Detroit: Become Human.
